nodes.label: DESIGN.md — RoBall3D design document
nodes.rationale: Pre-build spec: single source of truth for mechanics, numbers, and structure; every tunable number lives in Config.luau; all decisions final for MVP unless marked TBD.

nodes.label: AGENTS.md — agent workflow contract
nodes.rationale: Contract for agent work: read DESIGN.md before coding, tunables only in Config.luau, logic via Studio MCP + screenshots, playtest loop, verify before done.

nodes.label: README.md — project overview
nodes.rationale: Declares playable-MVP status and the implemented feature list; defers full spec to DESIGN.md and workflow to AGENTS.md.

nodes.label: Config.luau — all tunables
nodes.rationale: Single home for every tunable number (Generation.*, Obstacles.*, Speed.*, Tiers, Palette.HueStops, Music.AssetId) so gameplay code never inlines magic numbers.

nodes.label: ChunkDefs.luau — chunk type table + builders
nodes.rationale: Holds per-type weights, width rules, entry/exit constraints, and builder closures so every chunk stays constraint-honest.

nodes.label: GenCore.luau — pure seeded generator
nodes.rationale: Pure (rng, state) -> chunk spec: no math.random, no Instance creation — determinism is a leaderboard feature.

nodes.label: TrackStreamer.luau — spec -> Instances
nodes.rationale: Materializes chunk specs into Parts and destroys anything BehindDistance behind the ball; keeps AheadDistance of track alive.

nodes.label: BallDriver.luau — heartbeat velocity + kill plane
nodes.rationale: Server writes AssemblyLinearVelocity each Heartbeat (lateral, naturalY, forward) — velocity is authoritative, never position.

nodes.label: Main.client.luau — client boot, state machine, drive, chase cam
nodes.rationale: Client finds its ball by name in Workspace (<player>_Ball) instead of trusting remote args, because StreamingEnabled is OFF and unreplicated-instance args arrive nil.

nodes.label: Ui.luau — menu + HUD + death screen (all in code)
nodes.rationale: Menu built entirely in Luau so everything stays in git.

nodes.label: Backdrop.luau — retro sun + wireframe mountains
nodes.rationale: Client-local on purpose: zero replication cost, world-space recycling gives real parallax; sun kept inside Atmosphere's ~600-stud visible band.

nodes.label: MusicController.luau — tempo ramp + death slide (P6)
nodes.rationale: Wired and waiting on a real Music.AssetId; playback speed maps ball speed so the music literally accelerates with the run.

nodes.label: Ball Surfer 3D — neon ball identity reference
Super Monkey Ball — momentum physics reference
Design pillars (one-more-run tension, honest physics, vaporwave in motion, readable chaos)
nodes.rationale: The four pillars every mechanic must serve: instant restarts + climbing score; Monkey Ball momentum with no assists so deaths feel earned; shifting gradient/retro sun/wireframe horizon; track is random but fair — every death has a visible cause.

nodes.label: Slope REA: track is a wide slope face, not a ribbon
nodes.rationale: Most deaths come from obstacles, not edges, so generous width is core to feel — BaseWidth widened to ~16 ball-diameters early, narrowing per tier.

nodes.label: Slope REA: red = lethal, always
nodes.rationale: One-color hazard language means zero ambiguity; LethalColor is reserved for kill geometry and is never palette-shifted while edges/gems/scenery may hue-cycle.

nodes.label: Slope REA: obstacles are the mid-track threat; edges the ambient one
nodes.rationale: Slope atlas of blocks/walls/movers/tunnels/gaps — MVP adopts static BlockGate/BlockField/WallSlot; moving blocks and tunnels deferred post-MVP.

nodes.label: Slope REA: speed is continuous, not stepped
nodes.rationale: Pressure comes from shrinking reaction windows; eased tier targets approximate Slope's curve and Accel stays smooth so no step is felt.

nodes.label: Slope REA: exit-line fairness rule
nodes.rationale: 'A dodge that aims the ball at an edge is a partial failure' — every obstacle cluster must leave ≥1 corridor ≥ Obstacles.CorridorMin and lethal spacing ≥ tier speed * Obstacles.ReactionTime so every sequence stays solvable.

nodes.label: Slope REA: momentum steering + no brake
nodes.rationale: Lateral velocity persists after release; skill = early small inputs. The optional W/S throttle is a deliberate divergence for skill expression at a score-rate cost.

nodes.label: Slope REA: restart must feel free
nodes.rationale: Crash -> new run in ~1.5s is the addiction loop; the pre-menu auto-restart already implements this.

nodes.label: Closure contract — frozen entry-state snapshot
nodes.rationale: Section functions are evaluated lazily after generator state advances, so nextChunk hands every builder a frozen snapshot (centerX/width/y/zEnd). Reading live self.state once made geometry shift per-chunk and yAt return the generation frontier, spawning the ball under the world.

nodes.label: Velocity-authoritative ball
nodes.rationale: Ball is never directly positioned — velocity is authoritative so falls and ramp launches emerge from physics; this is what makes it feel like Monkey Ball.

nodes.label: Difficulty = distance function layered into tiers
nodes.rationale: Slope-style distance-based difficulty layered into GD-style tier beats so runs feel like they have chapters.

nodes.label: Backdrop is client-local
nodes.rationale: Zero replication cost and world-space recycling gives real parallax; sun tracks the ball SunDistance ahead inside the Atmosphere visible band.

nodes.label: GenCore must stay pure and seeded
nodes.rationale: GenCore takes Random and emits chunk specs — no math.random, no Instance creation; determinism is a leaderboard feature.

nodes.label: Constraint-honest chunk builders
nodes.rationale: Every chunk must declare entry width/speed requirements and exit state per DESIGN.md §8.1 so generated sequences stay completable.

nodes.label: Why StreamingEnabled is OFF
nodes.rationale: With StreamingEnabled OFF and CharacterAutoLoads=false there is no character, so streaming never delivers parts and RemoteEvent args referencing unreplicated instances arrive nil — client code finds its ball by name (<player>_Ball) instead.

nodes.label: Design-first rule — code and spec never drift
nodes.rationale: If a change contradicts DESIGN.md, update DESIGN.md in the same commit; never let code and spec drift.

nodes.label: Core loop: menu -> run -> death -> instant restart
nodes.rationale: Target session: first run ~30-60s, good runs 2-5min, deaths always explainable.

nodes.label: Momentum steering physics (A/D lateral accel, damped drift, optional W/S throttle)
nodes.rationale: 3-stud Ball Part, CustomPhysicalProperties (density 0.7, friction 0.6, elasticity 0); server sets AssemblyLinearVelocity per Heartbeat leaving Y to gravity. Optional throttle (+8%/-15%) is a deliberate divergence from Slope for skill expression at score-rate cost. No jump in MVP.

nodes.label: Chase camera
nodes.rationale: Offset (0,8,14), aimed 10 studs ahead; FOV eases 70->88 with speed; slight lateral lean for readability; no vertical bob to keep precision readable.

nodes.label: Menu / run / death-screen lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Code-built StarterGui menu (PLAY, seed TextBox, top-20 leaderboard, personal best); 0.8s rolling settle at start; death screen shows SCORE/DISTANCE/BEST/SEED with [R] instant restart — same seed if one was entered manually.

nodes.label: Seed system — map is a pure function of seed
nodes.rationale: Random.new(seed) drives all generation; default seed = tick() % 2^31; seed shown on death screen and stored with score so leaderboard rows are replayable/verifiable; text seeds hashed via stable string hash.

nodes.label: Chunk model — ordered chunks forming a wide descending slope face
nodes.rationale: Travel toward -Z always downhill (Generation.Grade drop per stud); chunks 30-90 studs with end state {width, centerX, height, exitSpeedReq} that the next entry must match; AheadDistance=400 / BehindDistance=250 streaming window; private lanes offset 600 studs in X.

nodes.label: Scripted intro — first 150 studs hand-authored
nodes.rationale: Flat(30,wide) -> Flat(30,gems) -> Slalom(40,gentle) -> Narrow(50,24->16) teaches auto-roll, drift, gems, and narrowing before the seeded generator takes over.

nodes.label: Narrow chunk (tier 2+, precision)
nodes.role: Width lerps down over the chunk

nodes.label: SplitGap chunk (tier 4+, route choice)
nodes.role: Center channel removed -> two side ribbons

nodes.label: Bowl chunk (tier 4+, rest + gem canyon)
nodes.role: Banked walls rise on both edges

nodes.label: RampGap chunk (tier 5+, speed check / spectacle)
nodes.rationale: Emits only when tier speed >= 64; entry speed v >= L/sqrt(2d/g) with g=196.2; generator picks L ≈ v*0.45, d=4.

nodes.label: BlockGate chunk (tier 2+, thread-the-gap)
nodes.role: Red blocks across deck, one gap >= CorridorMin

nodes.label: BlockField chunk (tier 3+, weaving pressure)
nodes.role: Scattered red blocks, density scales with tier

nodes.label: WallSlot chunk (tier 4+, commit-to-a-lane)
nodes.role: Red wall spanning deck, single opening

nodes.label: Risky-line gem placement
nodes.rationale: Explicit choice: gems cluster on risky lines (edge rails, narrow beams, arcs over RampGap voids, straight through obstacle corridors). Value scales with risk: safe 10 / edge 15 / beam 25 / gap-arc 40; 0-3 clusters per chunk, 3 gems, 3 studs apart; server Touched adds to Score.

nodes.label: Palette gradient system (HueStops, CycleDistance, CurrentColor/neonAt)
nodes.rationale: Single hue sampled from Palette.HueStops (magenta->purple->blue->cyan) advanced by distance, CycleDistance=400m/lap; one function feeds track edging, gem glow, sun stripes, mountain wireframe — generated by code, easily adjustable. LethalColor is exempt.

nodes.label: Difficulty tier system (Config.Tiers)
nodes.rationale: Crossing a threshold steps target speed 40->106 by 2000m (cap 110) eased at 6 studs/s², adds chunk types to the RNG pool, and tightens allowed width 24->4 min.

nodes.label: Scoring: floor(distance_m) + gem_points
nodes.rationale: Distance authoritative server-side (-Z traveled); death seals the score; server validation rejects scores above maxSpeed*elapsed*1.1 plus gem cap sanity.

nodes.label: Death model — kill plane + LethalColor Touched
nodes.rationale: Y drops below trackY-15 or ball touches LethalColor -> instant run over; music pitch slides to 0.6, camera pulls back. No lives/shields — explicitly deferred.

nodes.label: Two hazard classes: edges (ambient) + LethalColor obstacles (mid-track)
nodes.rationale: Both are instant death and must always read as the player's fault (readable chaos). LethalColor parts are CanCollide=true with server Touched kill; obstacles ride the deck surface and roll with rollDeg so Tilted chunks stay glued.

nodes.label: Persistence & leaderboard
nodes.rationale: Personal best + global top-20 shown in menu; Studio playtests need 'Enable Studio API Access' for DataStore writes.

nodes.label: Music tempo ramp + death slide
nodes.rationale: One looped synthwave track; Sound.PlaybackSpeed maps ball speed 0.9x->1.35x so music accelerates with the run; death slides pitch to floor, restart restores.

nodes.label: Retro sun + wireframe mountain backdrop
nodes.rationale: Striped sun on horizon ahead, procedural wireframe mountains flanking track from thin Parts/Beams, tinted by palette; sun sits at ~380 studs inside the haze band.

nodes.label: Private per-player lanes (600-stud X offsets, hidden by fog)
P1 — Ball + input + camera
nodes.done_when: Ball rolls at fixed speed, steers, falls, respawns

nodes.label: P3 — Tiers + gems + scoring
nodes.done_when: Speed tiers apply, risky gems score, death seals run

nodes.label: P5 — Persistence
nodes.done_when: Personal best + global board save/load in Studio test

nodes.label: P6 — Art pass
nodes.done_when: Palette gradient, backdrop, ball skin, bloom, music ramp

nodes.label: Explicitly out of scope (backlog)
nodes.rationale: Jump/dash, moving obstacles, tunnels, power-ups, touch controls, biomes, skins, social — all deferred but with designed-for extension points (chunk features, ChunkSpec.obstacles path); motion variants ride the same obstacle pipeline.

nodes.label: Studio MCP playtest loop
nodes.rationale: start_stop_play -> get_console_output -> assert via execute_luau (Server datamodel) -> stop; screen_capture verifies visuals; studio_id rotates on play/stop transitions.

nodes.label: Verify-before-done pipeline (stylua + selene + rojo build + MCP playtest)
Rojo 7.x / Luau toolchain
nodes.rationale: src/ maps into the DataModel via default.project.json; --!strict on every module; stylua + selene for style/lint; Studio MCP for in-engine edits.
